t.zh: 同一句话可以有好几个证明项，有的绕了远路：刚造出一样东西，马上又用掉。⟨p, q⟩.1 先拼后拆，算下来就是 p；框造出的函数马上用在 p 上，算下来是框里的证明，其中的 h 都换成 p。前两段先接出两条这样的弯路。
t.en: One sentence can have several terms, and some go the long way round: something made and at once used up. ⟨p, q⟩.1 joins and splits, and works out to p; a function from a box used on p at once works out to the proof inside, with every h replaced by p. The first two tasks wire two such detours.

t.zh: 拿掉弯路是一次计算：每一种弯路，核都有一条计算规则，把它换成算下来的样子。后两段证同样的两句，接出算下来的那一个。
t.en: Taking a detour out is a computation: for each kind of detour the kernel has a computation rule that puts what it works out to in its place. The last two tasks prove the same two sentences, wired as what they work out to.

after.zh: 算掉框的这一步叫<wiki-ref to="beta"></wiki-ref>；弯路一处不剩的证明项，叫<wiki-ref to="normal-form"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Computing a box away is <wiki-ref to="beta"></wiki-ref>; a term with no detour left is in <wiki-ref to="normal-form"></wiki-ref>.
